name: Orzel Bialy S.A.
summary: Orzel Bialy S.A. specializes in the production and global distribution of refined lead and various lead alloys, which are primarily recovered through the recycling of used batteries and other lead-containing waste materials. The company also supplies polypropylene and regranulated polypropylene, generated as byproducts from its battery reprocessing activities. Their principal customers are battery manufacturers, particularly those serving the automotive sector. Established in 1858, the firm is headquartered in Piekary Slaskie, Poland, and has operated as a subsidiary of ZAP Sznajder Batterien S.A. since October 7, 2019.
